# claude-persian-font

> A Claude Code plugin that makes the Claude desktop app on macOS draw Persian/Farsi text in a chosen font (Vazirmatn bundled; add your own). Latin text and code are untouched.

- [Setup steps for an AI agent](AGENTS.md): install the plugin and turn on Vazirmatn for a user.
- [README](README.md): what it does, install, known limitations (Persian and English).
- [Skill](skills/persian-font/SKILL.md): how to switch, add or remove fonts after install.
